title: Crispy Flaky Pie Crust
description: A simple recipe to make a delicious and flaky pie crust using quick fix ingredients.
instructions: Combine the flour, cold butter, and pastry mix in a large mixing bowl.
Add the water and mix until the dough comes together.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch pie dish.
Crimp the edges to seal the crust.
Prick the bottom of the crust with a fork to prevent it from bubbling.
Bake the crust for 20-25 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
Let the crust cool completely before filling and serving.
